newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): no official change to central subsidy rates in 2025-2026. The scheme's outlay and target run to FY 2026-27 (1 crore homes by March 2027). Talk of a 'PM Surya Ghar 2.0' is unconfirmed. The PIB progress release of 4 Aug 2026 (already cited) gives the 5.75% loan rate and 50.06 lakh homes.

findings.note: 'so you can get up to 300 units of electricity a month free' is supported by the Cabinet release ('providing free electricity up to 300 units every month'), but it is phrased as a personal promise and has no fact entry. The free units come from the household's own panels, and a 3 kW system generates 'more than 300 units a month on an average'.
findings.suggestion: Rephrase as 'The scheme aims to give homes up to 300 units of free electricity a month from their own panels.' Add a fact quoting the Cabinet release.

findings.note: The scheme period (to FY 2026-27, about five months away) is not stated. With reverify_days 90 that is acceptable.
findings.suggestion: Add 'The scheme currently runs until March 2027' once an official source with that date is snapshotted, and re-check in early 2027.

findings.note: bank_account is cited to cabinet_2024, which does not mention bank accounts. aadhaar is cited to the portal, whose snapshot is 72 bytes (title only).
findings.suggestion: Cite progress_2026 ('subsidy released directly to beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer') for the bank account. Snapshot a portal page that lists documents, or drop aadhaar.
